titlePage.p: Missa: Veni Pater Pauperum. | Di Francesco Tuma.

annot.p: This source comprises four works: Missa Veni Pater pauperum TumW A.19 (fol. 1–16), Missa Consolator optime TumW A.20 (fol. 17–30), Missa all’Onor delle cinque piaghe TumW A.16 (fol. 31–43), and Missa Auxilium meum a Domino TumW A.21 (fol. 44–59).
